family.description: This is the thioredoxin domain from in Thioredoxin domain-containing protein 17, also known as TRP14, which is a highly conserved and ubiquitously expressed oxidoreductase involved in controlling of cellular redox signalling pathways [[cite:PUB00032290]]. This domain is also found at the C-terminal of Acireductone dioxygenase (ARD) from Leishmania.
family.name: Thioredoxin domain-containing protein 17-like, thioredoxin domain
